Commentary.Commentary: How will West Indies reply on this belter of a pitch? The ground is pretty big and there were no maximums in the first innings but if anyone could clear the ropes here, it has to be the power-hitters from West Indies. Join us back in a short while for the run chase!

As for West Indies, Cottrell and Joseph were the only bowlers who threatened and the only ones who got into the wickets column as well. Cottrell and Joseph took 4 and 3 wickets each. As for the other bowlers, none of them could even create pressure on the Sri Lankan batters. The fielding by the West Indies was especially poor in this game as they put down several catches.

Sri Lanka were put into bat after losing the toss and in the initial stages, it was all going well for West Indies as the hosts were 2 wickets down for just 9 runs. They could have been 3 down had Pollard held onto the catch of Kusal Mendis and that is what came back to bite them. Kusal Mendis and Avishka Fernando then took the game away from the visitors as they stitched a marathon 239-run stand. In the final 10 overs, West Indies made a sort of a comeback as they took 6 wickets although conceding 99 runs. Sri Lanka would be a touch disappointed with their efforts in the death as they could have scored 20-30 runs more.

An awesome batting effort by Sri Lanka has seen them put on a massive total on the board and West Indies have a huge task at their hands. Pollard will not be happy with himself and his charges in regards to their fielding efforts but now they have to focus on the run chase.

OUT! Hasaranga is run out! Cottrell serves a slower length ball outside off, angling away, Wanindu shuffles across the stumps and tries to play the paddle shot. Fails to connect and they attempt to steal a bye. The keeper misses his shy at the striker's end and the ball rolls to the bowler. Cottrell picks it up and back flicks it onto the stumps as Wanindu dives in. It's referred upstairs and a few frames were enough to find Hasaranga short. SRI LANKA FINISH ON 345/8!
Appeal for a run out at the bowler's end. It's been referred upstairs...
Back of a length ball angling into the batsman, Wanindu hits it across the line through mid-wicket for a single.
Cottrell switches to 'round the wicket and slips a length ball down the leg side. Wanindu tries to flick but misses. It goes off his pads to short fine leg for a leg bye.
FOUR! Fantastic shot! Very full ball around leg, Hasaranga makes room and drills his drive through covers for a boundary.

DROPPED AGAIN! West Indies' fielding has been mediocre today. Slower full ball around leg, Udana heaves it over square leg and Fabian Allen drops a sitter. They take three runs. This is now Sri Lanka's highest total against West Indies in ODIs.
DROPPED AND FOUR! Fuller length ball outside off, Udana goes hard at it and edges it towards short third man. The fielder there jumps but it brushes his fingers and goes behind for a boundary.
Good length ball on off, Udana has lofted over the cover region. Pollard goes chasing after it and the batters take three runs.

DROPPED AND FOUR! A tough, tough chance and Holder has put it down. A good effort by Holder though. Short of a length ball on off, Udana slaps this one down the ground. Holder from long on runs to his left and dives. He gets both hands to it but the ball pops out and just about touches the fence.
Length ball outside off, Udana looks to power it over long off but mistimes it. Pollard runs back from mid off but cannot get to it and a couple taken.
Full toss on middle and off, lofted over the bowler's head powerfully but the man in the deep cuts it off and only one run comes off it.
Length ball outside off, Hasaranga plays this one towards point. Two fielders converge there to stop the second but amid some confusion they fail to do so.
FOUR! Freebie for Hasaranga and he makes full use of it! A slower full toss outside off, Hasaranga just opens the face of the bat and guides it past backward point for a boundary.
Keemo Paul is back on. 6-0-46-0 are his figures so far.
Good length ball on middle and off again, Udana plays it back towards Cottrell. Superb over by him! Just 2 runs and a wicket off it.
Good length ball on middle and off, Udana pushes this towards the mid on region but no runs on offer.
Good length ball around off, moving away. Udana looks to have a poke at it but misses.
Isuru Udana is the new man in.

OUT! TIMBER! You miss, I hit and Cottrell again brings out the salute although it is a tired one. He along with Joseph have been good for the West Indies here. A slower ball just around off, coming into Perera. Thisara looks to go for a wild heave towards mid-wicket but misses and the stumps are disturbed. West Indies trying to finish the innings with a flurry of wickets.
Another full ball, this time on the off pole line, pushed towards sweeper cover for one.
Full ball on middle and leg, Perera makes room and heaves it down to long on but just a single.
This time Perera connects with his pull shot and gets a single as the ball goes towards square leg.
Perera looks to make room but Joseph follows him with a bouncer. Perera swings his bat but misses and falls down.
Back of a length ball on middle again, Perera pulls towards square leg for a couple.
Full ball on off, driven towards cover for one.
Length ball outside off, played towards backward point for a single.

Just short! Good length ball on the pads, Perera chips this one towards backward square leg. The man from the deep runs in but the ball falls short and the batters take two. Good running between the wickets.

FOUR! Off the gloves! Bouncer again, this time Hasaranga looks to pull but the ball kisses his gloves and goes over Shai Hope and into the fence behind him. Hasaranga is off the mark in unconvincing although effective fashion.
Bouncer on middle and off, Hasaranga, the hero of the last match, ducks under it.
Wanindu Hasaranga walks out to bat next.

OUT! BOWLED! Again the salute comes out and this time de Silva walks back. Length ball around the leg pole line, it is a leg cutter. De Silva looks to hit this one over the off side but misses. Cottrell though hits and the middle and leg poles are disturbed. The Lankan charge is being halted a bit at the death by the Windies.

EDGED AND FOUR! Nothing going West Indies' way right now! Length ball outside off, de Silva swings his bat at this one and the ball flies off the outside edge towards third man and into the fence in a flash.
In the air but safe! Back of a length ball on middle, Perera awkwardly pulls this one. The ball goes towards mid-wicket but falls short of the man in the deep and the batters take a single.
Good ball to start off the over, very full ball on the boots almost, Perera does well to dig it out towards wide long on for a couple.
Sheldon Cottrell is back on. 7-0-42-2 are his figures so far.

Perera plays this length ball on off towards point and sets off for a single. The man there has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses. One run completed and Perera will keep strike for the next over.
Bouncer on middle again, Perera looks to pull but misses.
Bouncer on middle and leg, Perera ducks under it.
A very full ball angling into de Silva, he looks to defend but the ball goes off the inside edge onto the pads and then towards the off side. The batters steal a single.
This time Perera plays this one towards the man at point for a single.
EDGED AND FOUR! Lucky Perera! High full toss on the middle and off pole, Perera looks to make room and help it towards point but the ball takes a thick outside edge and races to the third man fence.
A lovely flowing cover drive by Thisara but this time it has been stopped with a dive near the edge of the box. A single to complete a 15-run over.
Too full in length outside off, Perera reaches out for it with an open face and steers it behind point for a couple.
Excellent running! Back of a length delivery outside off, Dhananjaya slaps it to deep cover-point for a couple of runs. They take another run on the throw.
FOUR! Poor delivery with mid off up in the circle. Fullish floating delivery outside off, Dhananjaya lifts it over the infield and fetches a boundary.
Slower delivery, on the shorter side around off, gripping and holding off the surface, Perera checks his shot in the air and pushes it aerially towards covers. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Uppish but safe! Fuller length delivery outside off, Thisara drives it aerially but wide of the diving extra cover fielder. No protection behind in the deep and it's a boundary.
Dhananjaya de Silva is the new batsman in. Keemo Paul is back on.

OUT! TIMBER! The middle stump has come off the ground and Mathews departs for just one run. A full ball on middle and off, nipping in. Mathews looks to flick but the ball goes off the inside edge onto the stumps and the middle pole is off its groove. Mathews walks back without doing anything substantial in his 100th ODI at home! Outstanding over by Alzarri, 5 runs and a couple of wickets in it!
Length ball on middle, pulled towards mid-wicket for one.
Full ball on the pads again, Mathews flicks it towards mid-wicket and changes ends to get off the mark.
On the pads, worked towards the leg side for a single.
Angelo Mathews is the next batsman in. 100th ODI for him in Sri Lanka.

OUT! CAUGHT! The dropped catch of Fernando does not cost a lot and Paul will be a relieved man. However, Fernando has played a fantastic knock here and is going off the pitch with his head and bat held high. Fernando looks to make room and go over the off side but Joseph follows him with a short ball. Fernando looks to pull but mistimes it. The ball goes high towards the man at mid-wicket where Keemo Paul takes an easy catch. West Indies looking to peg Sri Lanka back at the death.

DROPPED! It was an easy catch but Keemo has dropped it and let Fernando off the hook! Length ball on middle and off, Fernando rocks back and looks to heave it over mid-wicket. The ball goes off the top half of the bat towards deep mid-wicket. Paul there settles under it but puts down an easy catch. The fielding has been very sloppy by the Windies here! The batsmen take a couple.
FOUR! Perera indeed makes it count! Very poor delivery by Holder. From 'round the wicket angle, he serves a full ball on the pads and Thisara smashes it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Free Hit time! Thisara Perera on strike, can he make it count?
Holder oversteps now! Nothing going for West Indies at the moment. Fuller and on middle, Fernando tries to whip it across the line but inside edges it to deep square leg for a run.
Slower short ball on middle, Fernando stands back and powers it down to long on for a run. Thisara pushes his partner and gets the second run as well.

FOUR! Brilliant hit! Fernando has hit it into the wind but still manages to send it to the fence. Holder comes up with another full toss, following the batsman down the leg side, Avishka swings his bat and nails it in front of square leg for a boundary.
Holder switches to 'round the wicket and serves a very full ball outside off, Thisara reaches out for it and squeezes it down to third man for a run.
Long off drops back. Square leg comes up. Holder has to be full with his length.
FOUR! Slapped! Short in length and outside off, Perera attacks it and slaps it over backward point for a boundary. Poor line and length by Holder.
Starts his spell by following the batsman down the leg side with a full toss, Fernando swings it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Jason Holder (7-0-41-0) is back on.
Bouncer on middle and leg, Perera ducks under it and lets it go.
Full ball on middle and off, pushed down to long on for one.

Fernando almost threw his wicket away here! Full ball on the pads, Perera flicks this one towards mid-wicket. The batters complete the single but Fernando wants the second. He sets off but Perera says no. He is almost halfway down the pitch before he decides to return. The throw goes towards Shai Hope but he has to come in front of the stumps to collect the ball. Hope catches the ball and tries to flick it onto the stumps behind him but misses. Had he hit, this would have been a very close call. With this single, 250 also comes up for Sri Lanka.
On the pads of Fernando, he flicks this one towards the leg side and takes the single.
Thisara Perera is promoted to bat at number 5! The stage is set for him to play his kind of innings.

OUT! CAUGHT! Finally a breakthrough for West Indies and Kusal Mendis departs after a fantastic knock. He soaks in the applause from the crowd as he lifts his bat. Length delivery on middle and off, Mendis looks to heave this one towards the mid-wicket region. It is an off cutter by Joseph. The ball takes the top edge and goes high in the air. Shai Hope calls for it, settles under it just where the short leg fielder would have been positioned and takes the catch. The 239-run stand is broken and Mendis has made the full use of the life he got.

Full ball on middle and off, Mendis again goes for the paddle scoop but does not time it properly. The ball goes high in the air towards fine leg. However, it falls short and bounces first in front of the fielder. Then it goes above his head and behind him and the batters take two.

Powerplay 3 is underway! A maximum of 5 fielders are now allowed outside the circle. West Indies will need each one of them with Mendis and Fernando well set. Alzarri Joseph is back on. 6-0-33-0, his figures so far.

Goes hard at a length ball around off and inside edges it behind square leg. The short fine leg fielder misfields slightly and they take two. 19 from the over and Sri Lanka are 246/2 with 10 overs remaining.

FOUR! Raining boundaries in Hambantota and the Lankan crowd is loving it. Good length ball around middle and off, Avishka gives it the full whack of his bat and powers it to long off for a boundary. There was a fielder in the deep this time but still he fails to get across it.

FOUR! 13 from the over already! This is now the highest partnership for any wicket in ODIs in Sri Lanka. They are targeting the long off fence with the fielder up inside the ring. Once again Avishka makes room and lofts it over the infield for a boundary.
FOUR! Pollard is under attack here. Fuller length ball in the line of the stumps, Fernando hops back to make room and muscles it over the bowler's head.
Uses the angle of the bowler and lifts it over mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! Fine shot! Back of a length ball around off, Mendis backs away to make room and pumps it over mid off for a boundary. The charge is well and truly on.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat. 13 from the over!
Good length ball on off, punched towards mid off and the batters take a quick single.
FOUR! Good length ball on the pads, Mendis whips it just behind square leg and the ball has raced away to the fence again.

FOUR! This time Mendis connects! Cottrell bowls it on a good length on off, again Mendis goes for the paddle scoop and times it perfectly. The ball goes over the head of Shai Hope and into the third man fence.
Good length ball outside off, Mendis looks to shuffle and paddle scoop this ball over the keeper's head but misses.
Good length ball on middle and off, Fernando works this one towards mid-wicket for one.
THREE WIDES! Down the leg side, Fernando looks to flick but misses. It is too wide for Hope to get anything on it. The ball rolls towards fine leg as the batters run two. Three wides!

Hundred for Avishka Fernando now! His second ODI ton and he pumps his fists with delight. Length ball outside off, Fernando pushes it into the gap at cover-point and gets the single to reach his ton. With both batters reaching their milestones, an onslaught could well be on the cards.
On the pads, worked towards mid-wicket for a single.
Paul drags his length back this time as he bowls it on middle. Fernando goes onto the back foot and punches it towards long on for one.
Another one which is full in length, this time around middle, punched down to long on for one.
Full ball on off, pushed towards the man at mid off.
Length ball on middle, pulled towards square leg and Fernando changes ends. Looks under no pressure whatsoever.
On the pads, flicked towards the leg side for a single.
Back of a length ball on middle, Mendis rocks back and pulls it towards square leg for a single.
Good length ball on middle and off, Fernando punches it wide of mid off for a single.

100 for Kusal Mendis! His 2nd ODI ton and he has surely made the most of the life he got when he was dropped on 2 runs. Full ball on off, Mendis pierces the gap at covers and takes a single to get to his ton. He pumps his fists in the air and now will be looking to go hard at the Windies bowlers.
Good length ball on middle and off, played towards the man at mid on.
Length ball on off, played towards point.
Fernando has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Length ball on middle and off, punched towards long on for a single.
Full ball on the pads of Fernando, he flicks it behind square leg and takes a single. West Indies giving away easy singles.
Full ball on middle and off, driven towards long on for one.
Full ball on middle and off, defended towards the man at cover.
On the pads of Fernando, he works this one towards mid-wicket for a single.
Keemo Paul is back on. 3-0-22-0, his figures so far.
On the pads, worked towards the leg side for a single.
Fernando has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Back of a length delivery on middle, pulled towards square leg for a single. 200 up for Sri Lanka!

Run out chance! Good length ball around off, Fernando guides it to the left of backward point. Mendis sets off for a run. Fabian Allen there picks up the ball and has a shy at the striker's end but misses. Mendis reaches with a dive. Anyway, he would have been safe even in the case of a direct hit.
Length ball outside off, Mendis tickles it down to third man for a single.
Cottrell starts off with a full ball around middle and off, Mendis defends this towards the off side.

A plate of watermelon is coming out for Kusal Mendis and Avishka Fernando as it's time for the second DRINKS break. Sri Lanka have been put in a strong position courtesy a magnificent partnership between the current pair. Both the batsmen are in the 90s and we can expect them to press on the accelerator even more after reaching their respective milestones. For West Indies, it will be all about limiting the damage from here on. 16 more overs left in the innings. Sheldon Cottrell (4-0-21-2) to operate after the mini-break.

On the pads, Mendis flicks this one towards mid-wicket and takes a single. The partnership now moves to a massive 188 runs. This is the highest ODI stand that they have ever had against the West Indies for any wicket.
Flatter delivery on middle and off, Fernando punches this towards long on off the back foot for one.
This time Fernando drives it wide of the fielder at long on and that allows the batters to take a couple.
Another flatter one on middle and off, Mendis pushes it towards long on and takes one.
Fernando pushes this one towards mid off and takes a single.
Flatter one on middle, pushed down to long on for a single.
Length ball outside off, Mendis this time beats the man at short third man. The ball is going towards the fence but the fielder chases it down and the batters take three.
Nothing comes off it! Good bowling by Pollard! He bowls a slower one outside off. Mendis goes for a wild swing but misses.
No ball! Overstepping by Pollard! Good length ball outside off, Mendis helps it down towards short third man again. Free Hit coming up.
Length ball outside off, Mendis guides it straight to the fielder at short third man.
Good length ball on middle and off, Mendis goes down on one knee and plays the sweep shot towards square leg for a couple.
Good length ball on off, pushed towards covers for a single.

Confusion but safe! Good length ball on the pads of Fernando, he flicks this towards mid-wicket but the man there dives and makes the stop. Mendis had took off for a run but is sent back in time by Fernando.
Flatter delivery on middle and off, defended out by Kusal.
Flatter delivery outside off, Mendis opens the face of the bat and guides this one past short third man for a couple.
Tossed up around middle, worked down towards mid on for a single.
Flatter one on off, pushed towards covers for one.
Floated delivery on middle and off, Mendis comes down the track and lofts this one towards deep mid-wicket and the batters take two.
Flatter delivery outside off, Mendis comes ahead and looks to defend but the ball hits his pads.
Slower short ball on middle, Mendis turns it behind square leg for a single. 7 runs off the last two overs, WI trying to pull things back slightly.
Pollard goes wide of the crease and angles in a length ball outside off, Avishka pushes it to covers for a run.
Full ball on the pads, it's helped to mid-wicket.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Fullish and on off, Mendis comes down the track and pushes it to long on for one.
A length delivery on middle, Mendis defends it on the leg side.
The skipper, Kieron Pollard, brings himself on. Can he break this formidable stand?
Skidding down the leg side, swept again, this time behind square leg for one.
Goes down on one knee and mistimes his sweep shot towards fine leg for a run.
Fernando has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

NOT OUT! Easily in. Tossed up ball on middle, fuller in length, Kusal sweeps it straight towards short fine leg and sets off for a run. The fielder picks up the ball and scores a direct hit at the striker's end. They appeal and the square leg umpire refers it upstairs. The replays roll in and the first frame is enough to judge Fernando safe.
Appeal for a run out after there is a direct hit at the striker's end. The umpire takes it upstairs. No real excitement shown by the West Indian players.
Full and flighted ball on middle, Mendis pushes it back to the bowler.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Roston Chase is back on. 3-0-14-0, his figures so far.
Angling down the leg side, it's eased behind square leg for three runs. 10 from the over, Sri Lanka's charge is on!

APPEAL FOR A CATCH! Is it a bump ball? The umpires get together and refer it upstairs. A low full toss on off, Avishka opens the face of the bat and pushes it towards point. The fielder there makes a fine stop but West Indies feel that it has carried on the full to the fielder. The replays show that it bumped.
Full again, on middle and angling in, Mendis flicks it to deep square leg and milks another run from Joseph's over.
Fuller length ball on middle, Fernando inside edges his attempted flick shot through square leg for a run.
FOUR! Thumped! Joseph has been struggling with his lines and once again drifts down the leg side. It's short and Fernando swings his bat across the line to put it behind square leg for a boundary.
Shortish and on off, Mendis pulls it through backward square leg for a single.

Quicker one, full and around leg, skidding down, Mendis tries to sweep but fails to middle it properly. It probably takes an inside edge and runs towards fine leg. They collect three runs. 150-run stand comes up!
A bit of a mishit! Loopy full ball around off, spinning away, Fernando slices his attempted lofted shot over extra cover towards the fielder at deep cover. A single taken.
Fires a quicker and flatter ball on middle, Avishka punches but finds Pollard at extra cover.
Uses his feet to take it on the full and drives it down to long off for one.
Flatter and shorter on off, Mendis punches it to covers.
Goes on the back foot and cuts it to cover-point for a run.
Angling down the leg side, it's nudged behind square leg for a run.

Good running between the wickets! Shortish and on off, Fernando hits it firmly to deep mid-wicket and scampers back for the second run. The fielder sends across a flat throw to the keeper but Avishka has arrived before that.
Wide! Wrong line from the bowler, slips a length ball down the leg side, Fernando attempts to flick but misses.
The batsman picked that bouncer early and lets it through to the keeper.
Too full in length on middle, Avishka keeps it out safely to mid on.
Width on offer outside off, Mendis guides it to third man. They pick up a single.
Fuller in length on middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a run.
Alzarri Joseph is back on. 4-0-17-0, his figures so far. Can he provide the much-needed breakthrough?

FOUR! And again. A drop kick by Mendis. He uses his feet to come down the track, keeps himself away from the line of the delivery so that he has ample room to free his arms. After that, it's all too easy for a batsman of his caliber. Mendis chips it over extra cover and fetches another boundary for himself. 9 from the over!
Allen responds by firing in a short and wide delivery outside off, Mendis cuts but finds short third man.
FOUR! Quality shot! Mendis was finding it difficult to pierce the gap so he decides to go aerial. Full and floated around off, Mendis charges down the track and lofts it cleanly over extra cover.
Flighted and full on off, Mendis drives but this time it's to the right of extra cover. Dot again.
Uses his feet and drives a full ball to the left of extra cover. The fielder quickly gets to the ball and it's a dot.
Flatter and a touch shorter on off, Fernando camps back and punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Fabian Allen is back on. 4-0-22-0, his figures so far.

Very full in length on middle, Fernando tries to whip it on the leg side but gets an inside edge onto the pads. It rolls and stops near the surface and Mendis calls his partner through for a quick run. 11 from the over and Sri Lanka continue to progress.
Too full in length on middle, Fernando digs it out back in the direction of the bowler. Holder slides to make the stop.
Get the boundary, get the single. Keep the scoreboard ticking. Clever batting. Full in length on middle, Kusal helps it through mid-wicket for a run.

FOUR! Once again this is brilliant batting! This time by Kusal Mendis. Holder digs in a short delivery outside off, Mendis uses the pace of the bowler and guides it down to third man for the second boundary in the over.
On a length around middle, Avishka strokes it past the bowler for a run at long on.
FOUR! Excellent batting! Holder goes short with his length and pitches it close to off, Avishka makes room and slaps it square of the wicket on the off side for a boundary.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. They pick up a single. These two are looking largely untroubled in this partnership.
Very full in length on off, Kusal forces it past the diving bowler for a run at long on.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and punches it to long on for one.
Quicker one on middle, Mendis turns it through square leg and takes a single.
Flatter and a touch shorter close to off, Mendis goes back to cut but chops it down off the inner edge.
Flighted off spinner on middle, fuller in length, Kusal flicks but finds Pollard at mid-wicket.
Shortish and on off, it's hit past mid-wicket for a single.
Short delivery on off, it carries some extra bounce, Fernando pulls but fails to middle his shot properly. Finds mid-wicket.
A length delivery on middle, it's worked off the pads through square leg for a couple of runs.
Nicely played! Back of a length delivery close to off, Mendis goes on his toes and chops it down past the diving backward point fielder for a single.
Short and on off, angling in, Avishka pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Good length ball around off, Fernando defends it back from the crease.
Jason Holder is back into the attack. His figures so far are 5-0-26-0.
Once again it's quicker through the air, full and on middle, Kusal drives it back. Chase goes on to collect the ball and collides with the non-striker, bringing him down.
Quicker and fuller on middle, Mendis pushes it back to the bowler.
This time Avishka clips it in front of square leg and rotates the strike.
Flighted and full on middle, Fernando flicks but finds mid-wicket.
Allows the ball to spin back into him and then helps it behind square leg for one.
Flighted and full ball on off, it's eased down to long on for a run.
Fuller ball on middle and off, driven down to long on for a single. 10 runs off the over and the Lankans are playing free-flowing cricket right now.
On the pads, worked towards square leg and the batters take a single.
Wide! Down the leg side, Mendis looks to go down and sweep but misses.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full ball on middle and off, Mendis pushes it down the ground. The man from mid off chases it down and the batters take two.

FOUR! Half ton for Kusal Mendis as well and this is his 17th in ODIs. A very well-compiled innings by him. Back of a length ball on middle, Mendis rocks back and pulls it towards mid-wicket for a boundary. This also brings up the 100-run stand between Mendis and Fernando. They are playing very well and laying down the foundations after two early wickets.
Good length ball on middle and off, pushed down to long on for one.
FOUR! Superb shot! Flatter delivery on off, Mendis rocks back and cuts it through backward point for a boundary.
Floated on off, pushed towards the man at cover.
Tossed up on middle, pushed down to long on for one.

4th ODI fifty for Avishka Fernando! A very mature innings this one but he needs to keep going now. Chase bowls this one on the pads of Fernando, he flicks this one towards square leg and takes a couple. This is the first time that Fernando has got back-to-back half tons in ODIs.
This time flatter and fuller in length, Fernando pushes it back towards the bowler.
Flatter ball around middle, Avishka goes back and defends it out.
Roston Chase is into the attack, replacing Fabian Allen. He will be spinning into the right-handers and there will be a temptation to take him on.
100 up for Sri Lanka and they've done superbly to come out of a perilous situation. On the pads of Fernando, he works this one in front of square leg and the batters change ends.
Length ball just outside off, Mendis guides it down to backward point and takes a single.
Good length ball on middle and off, played back towards the bowler.
Fuller ball on middle by Paul, pushed towards mid on for a single. Runs coming at a good rate for the Lankans without too much trouble.
Good length ball outside off, Mendis opens the face of the bat and guides this one towards third man for one.
Fuller ball on the pads, Fernando tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter delivery outside off, Mendis guides this one down to third man and the batters take a couple. 8 runs off the over and a good one for Sri Lanka.
Flatter delivery around off, Mendis rocks back and defends.
FOUR! Well played by Mendis! Full and floated delivery around leg by Allen, Mendis drives this wonderfully wide of the mid on fielder and the ball races away to the fence.
Another flatter delivery on off, Mendis looks to pierce the gap at covers by making room but fails to do so.
Flatter delivery outside off this time, Fernando punches it towards cover-point for one.
Floated on middle and leg  by Allen, Mendis pushes it towards mid on and takes one.
Good length ball outside off, Mendis guides this down to third man and takes a single to end the over.
Fullish ball around off, Mendis defends this one out.
This time a much easier single at mid on as Fernando pushes it wide of the man over there.

Very good running! Good length ball on middle and leg, it's pushed towards mid on and the batters set off for one. The man from mid on rushes towards the ball and has a shy at the non-striker's end. He hits but Mendis is well in by then.
FOUR! Not too much bounce or pace on it and Mendis punishes Paul! Back of a length ball on middle and leg, Mendis rocks onto the back foot and pulls this one towards mid-wicket for a boundary.
Paul starts with a good length delivery outside off, Mendis plays this easily towards the man at point.

Drinks break. It's been a good recovery by Sri Lanka. They suffered a couple of early blows but since then Fernando and Mendis have brought them back on track with a solid stand. West Indies dropped Kusal Mendis on 2 and that will be hurting them. The pitch appears to be excellent for stroke-making and the touring team will have to bowl well in the middle phase. Keemo Paul to bowl for the first time in this match...

Run out chance missed! Floated delivery on off, Mendis pushes this towards the cover region. Mendis sets off for a single but it is a risky one. Pollard at covers picks up the ball and has a shy at the keeper's end but his throw is a touch wide and Fernando makes it in easily by then.
Tossed up delivery around off, Fernando drives it towards mid on and takes one.
Flatter delivery around middle and off, Fernando goes back and defends.
Floated delivery on off, Mendis gets down on one knee and sweeps it towards square leg for a single.
Floated delivery around off, Mendis pushes this one towards the off side.
Flatter delivery around off, Fernando rocks back and punches this towards covers for one.
Good length ball on off, Mendis plays this one straight to the man at point. Just 3 runs off the over.
Full ball on off, Fernando opens the face of the bat to guide it down to third man for one.
Another full ball, this time around the off pole line. Mendis shuffles across a touch and works this towards square leg for one.
Fuller ball on middle and leg, worked towards the man at mid on.
On the pads, Fernando flicks this one towards mid-wicket for a single.
Full ball around off, Avishka plays this one past Joseph down the ground but the man from mid on runs to his left and cuts it off.
Again the length is very full and it's knocked down to long on for another run in this over.
Too full in length on off, Avishka pushes it back to the bowler.
Quicker and flatter on off, fuller in length, Fernando drives it towards the cover region where the fielder fails to make a clean stop and the batters collect a couple.
Leans forward to a full ball and drives it down to long off for a single.
Allen gets away with a bad delivery! Short and outside off, Mendis cuts from the back foot but finds backward point.
Full and flighted on off, the batsman gets forward and drives it back to the bowler.

FOUR! Good execution by Fernando! Length ball just outside off, it nips away and there is some extra bounce on it. Fernando just opens the face of the bat and guides it wide of Shai Hope and the ball races away to the third man fence. 8 runs off the over.
Back of a length ball around middle, Fernando looks to pull but does not time it perfectly. The ball travels to deep mid-wicket and the batters take two.
Down the leg side by Joseph, Fernando looks to flick but misses. The ball goes off the thigh pad towards fine leg and they steal two leg byes.
Another length ball just outside off, Fernando plays this one towards the man at point.
Length ball on middle and off, Fernando rocks back and defends it out.
Fullish ball to start the over by Joseph, around off, Fernando pushes it towards the man at mid off.
Floated on off again, Fernando pushes this towards covers and takes a single to end the over.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball back to the bowler.
Floated on off, pushed through mid off for a single.
This time Mendis connects with his sweep shot. The ball rolls towards deep square leg and he takes a couple. 50-run stand is also up between Mendis and Fernando.
Floated delivery on middle and leg, it is an arm ball. Mendis looks to play the sweep shot but is hit on the pads. The Lankan players appeal but the umpire says not out. Missing leg.
Flatter delivery on middle and leg, a touch short in length, Mendis goes down on one knee and pulls this in front of square leg for a couple.
Spin time! Fabian Allen is into the attack now.
On the pads, Mendis works this one towards square leg and keeps strike for the next over by taking a single.
Fullish ball on middle and leg, worked towards the man at wide mid on.
Good length ball outside off by Joseph, Fernando runs it down to third man and takes a single.
Fuller one on off now, driven towards the man at cover.
Wide! Another one down the leg side, Fernando looks to flick but misses it completely.
Back of a length ball on middle and leg, pulled towards square leg for a single.
Wide! Down the leg side, Mendis looks to flick but misses.
50 up for Sri Lanka! Good length ball on off, Fernando pushes it towards the off side and takes an easy single.
Powerplay 2 begins! A maximum of 4 fielders are now allowed outside the ring till the 40th over.
Length ball just outside off, left alone by Mendis. End of Powerplay 1 and Sri Lanka are 49/2.
Wide! Down the leg side, Mendis looks to flick but misses. The West Indies players appeal for a caught behind but the umpire signals a wide.
Good length ball outside off, Mendis defends this off the back foot.
Down the leg side by Holder, Mendis looks to flick but it goes off his thigh pad towards Shai Hope who collects it.
Back of a length ball on middle and off, Mendis gets on top of this one and pushes it towards mid on.
Length ball on off, Fernando punches it towards covers off the back foot and changes ends.
EDGED AND FOUR! Good length ball on middle and off, angling in, Fernando looks to loft this one over the mid on region but the ball goes off the inside edge and crosses the fine leg fence.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Avishka has driven it to the left of mid off. One run added to the total.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman. No run.
Mendis opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single.
A touch short in length on middle, Mendis gets back and helps it to square leg.
Starts his spell with a fuller length ball on off, Mendis drives but finds mid off.
Alzarri Joseph is into the attack now, replacing Sheldon Cottrell.
Tickles a length ball behind square leg and picks up a run. 8 from the over, 19 in the last two, Sri Lanka growing well in this game after early hiccups.

Aerial but safe! Gets lucky, very lucky. Fernando was in no control of the shot. Back of a length ball on middle, Avishka tries to force it on the leg side from the back foot but mistimes it over the bowler's head. It drops safely and then slowly runs away. Chase chases it down and the batsmen complete three runs.
Misses out! Straighter delivery by Holder, Avishka clips it off his pads but finds short fine leg.
FOUR! Shot! Fractionally short and around off, sitting up nicely, Fernando gets on top of the bounce and hammers his pull shot over mid-wicket.
Angles in a length ball on off, stopping a bit onto the batsman, Avishka checks his drive and pushes it a bit uppishly towards mid off.
Good length ball on off, it's punched from the back foot to mid off.
Outside off, Kusal has nothing to do with it. 11 from the over, a good one for Sri Lanka.

FOUR! Well controlled pull shot again by Kusal Mendis. Once again he picks the length very early. Realizes it's short and around middle, Mendis just guides his pull shot with minimum swing of his bat. It races through square leg for a boundary. There is good value for shots on this pitch.
Fullish and on off, Mendis toe-ends his attempted off drive to mid off.

FOUR! Well played! From the middle of the bat. Short in length on middle, Mendis goes on his toes an turns to pull it in front of square leg. Good timing and this time the ball scales the boundary line.
Fullish and outside off, Mendis drives it through the line but finds the cover-point fielder.
Wide! Shortish delivery and wide outside off, Kusal allows it through.
Fullish ball around off, it's nicely eased into the gap at extra cover for a couple of runs. 2000 ODI runs for Kusal Mendis!
Another back foot punch by Avishka finds the bowler in his followthrough. Some tidy bowling going on from West Indies!
A length ball on off, Fernando punches it back in the direction of the bowler.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Angling into the batsman, on a length, Fernando tries to punch it through the line but it takes the inner half and runs past short fine leg. The batsmen collect a couple this time.
Shortish and around off, Mendis stands back and hits it in front of square leg. The fine leg fielder sprints across to his left and the ball slows down as well. Another three for Sri Lanka.
Good length ball on off, Mendis stays back and plays it down to point.
Cottrell keeps it full and straight, Fernando bunts it down to mid on. Another tidy over by Sheldon.
A low full toss this time, Avishka drives again but this time it goes straight to mid off.
Pitches it up and outside off, Fernando leans into the drive but finds the cover fielder.
A yorker to follow the last ball, around off, Fernando does well to dig it out safely.

FOUR! Edgy! Very flashy from Sri Lanka at the moment. Cottrell offers width outside off, it's short and wide outside off, Avishka throws his bat at it and edges it down to third man for a boundary. The fielder in the deep was quite square.
Good length delivery on middle and off, Fernando defends it from the back foot to the off side.

Halt in play as the physio has come out now. Kusal Mendis has been hit on the wrist of his right hand and he looks in some serious pain. The magic spray is out and the Lankans will be hoping that this is not too serious.

Ouch, that has hurt Kusal Mendis! He is in immense pain. Holder gets a length ball to cut back into the batsman with some extra bounce. Mendis tries to defend it off his front foot but misses and takes a blow on his right wrist. Kusal immediately pulls out.
Wide! Drifting down the leg side, Mendis tries to flick but misses.
Mendis has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

DROPPED BY POLLARD! Now, that's a rarity. Polly has hands like a bucket but still he fails to gobble it. A length ball close to off, straightening a hint with extra bounce, Mendis brings down a straight bat to defend but it takes the outside edge and flies to Kieron at first slip. The West Indian skipper goes down low but it slips out from his hands. Early life for Mendis, can he make the visitors pay for it?
A length ball close to off, Fernando tries to push it through the line but edges it towards short fine leg. They cross for a quick run as the fielder is a bit lazy in reacting.
Back of a length ball on middle, angling in, Avishka stays back and helps it to mid on.
Short in length around off, Fernando goes on his back foot and keeps it out safely on the off side.
Shortish and on off, played from the back foot to point. Exemplary over by Sheldon, 2 wickets and 5 runs from it!

False shot! Play and a miss. They need to be careful with their shot selection. Plenty of overs left and this is a batting beauty. Spend some time in the middle and stroke-making is going to be easy. A length ball outside off, angling away, Mendis gets forward to drive it away from his body but misses.
No hat-trick! The idea is right from Sheldon, he goes for an inswinging delivery but the length is very full and around off, Mendis drives it past mid off for a couple of runs.
Kusal Mendis walks out to bat now, way earlier than he would have expected. He will be facing the hat-trick ball against Sheldon Cottrell. Can he survive? Two slips and a short mid-wicket in place.

OUT! Edged and gone! A golden duck for Kusal Perera in his 100th ODI! Sri Lanka in some early trouble. Yet again there is nothing extraordinary with the delivery. It's on a length and wide outside off, Perera spots the chance to blast it through covers but the ball nips away a shade to kiss the outside edge. Shai Hope makes no mistake and here comes another salute from Sheldon Cottrell. He is on a hat-trick!
Kusal Perera walks in to bat now, replacing his skipper.

OUT! Soft, soft dismissal for the Lankan skipper. Cottrell delivers it short and wide outside off, there to be hit, Karunaratne reaches out with his attempted square cut but fails to keep it down. It goes straight to Fabian Allen at point who accepts the dolly. Karunaratne gets a military send-off from Sheldon. Early success for West Indies!

Superbly played! Shortish and around off, Fernando stays back and punches it past his partner at the other end. The mid off fielder takes his own sweet time to chase it down and the Lankan openers take another three.
Just a tad short in length around off, Karunaratne hangs back to stroke it through the line but finds the point fielder.
Slightly short in length and the line is on middle and leg, Fernando lifts his front leg and pulls it behind square leg for a single.
Karunaratne is off the mark! A delivery on his pads and the Lankan skipper nudges it to fine leg for one.

Nicely played! Back of a length ball on off, some extra bounce as well, Fernando does well to punch it through cover-point. It's chased down in the deep and the batsmen take three runs. It's a big ground, so you are going to see plenty of 3s in this match!
Yet another length delivery on off, Avishka sticks back to push it through the line but gets an inside edge onto the pads. It then deflects to covers.
Good length ball on off, at 128 kph, Fernando is behind the line in defense.
Jason Holder to run in with the second new ball.
On and around off, a length ball, Karunaratne blocks it solidly to covers. Tidy first over by Sheldon!
Cottrell pulls his length back slightly around off, Dimuth moves back and mishits it in the direction of mid on.
Identical to the last delivery, minus any movement, Karunaratne connects with his front foot cover drive but picks out the fielder.
Beaten on the drive! Cottrell pitches it up this time and delivers it outside off, Karunaratne thinks about driving it through covers but it nips away to beat the outside edge.
Fractionally short again, it's around off, Karunaratne stays on the back foot and taps it down towards point.
A gully in place for Dimuth Karunaratne.
Starts with a back of a length delivery in the region around off, Fernando gets back and pushes it in the gap at covers for a single. Sri Lanka are underway!

Time to play the game! Dimuth Karunaratne and Avishka Fernando are the Lankan openers. Bright and sunny out there at the moment and the conditions are looking ripe for batting. Sheldon Cottrell to kick off proceedings with the first new ball. A slip in place...

Pitch report - Strong wind is blowing across the ground and the bowlers will have to account for that. There are long boundaries so the batsmen will have to run hard. It's a high-scoring pitch with a good covering of grass. There are hardly any cracks and stroke-making will be easy. It's a very difficult ground to defend totals.

Sri Lanka (Unchanged Playing XI) - Dimuth Karunaratne (C), Avishka Fernando, Kusal Perera (WK), Kusal Mendis, Angelo Mathews, Dhananjaya de Silva, Thisara Perera, Wanindu Hasaranga, Isuru Udana, Lakshan Sandakan and Nuwan Pradeep.

West Indies (Playing XI) - Sunil Ambris, Shai Hope (WK), Darren Bravo, Roston Chase, Nicholas Pooran, Kieron Pollard(C), Jason Holder, Fabian Allen (In for Hayden Walsh), Keemo Paul, Alzarri Joseph and Sheldon Cottrell.

Toss - West Indies win the toss and ELECT TO FIELD! Kieron Pollard says that dew could be a factor here and the ball tends to come onto the bat well here. Informs about the one change to their Playing XI - Hayden Walsh is replaced by Fabian Allen. Adds that they had a chat about the last game and feels they need to learn to capitalize on the crunch moments. Dimuth Karunaratne would have batted first anyway and informs that they are unchanged from the last match. Adds that he wants his batters to convert starts and the bowlers to be more disciplined.
Milestone - Two players in the 100 club! This will be Kusal Perera's 100th ODI and Angelo Mathews' 100th ODI at home.

Hello and welcome everyone for the second ODI between Sri Lanka and West Indies in Hambantota. It was a thriller in Colombo where the home team edged out the Caribbean boys by a wicket. Given the closeness of that match, there is a big curiosity among everyone as we are expecting yet another humdinger between these two equally matched teams. Stay tuned for more...
